biggest_catch: Eligibility is very narrow - these studies are for formerly incarcerated / justice-involved people (and CT jail/prison workers), not the general public.
catches: Eligibility limited to formerly incarcerated adults and justice-involved populations (some studies CT-specific)
Some listed studies state only 'will be compensated' with no concrete amount - confirm before participating
Compensation is in gift cards, not cash
Sensitive topics (trauma, incarceration, mental health) - emotionally demanding studies
Studies recruit on their own schedules; availability varies

eligibility: Adults 18+ who are formerly incarcerated / justice-involved (per study criteria; some studies require CT residency or CT jail/prison/halfway-house work)

Complete the linked Qualtrics survey OR contact the study team (email/phone) to express interest
Complete the survey or 60-90 minute interview
Receive the stated gift-card compensation per completed study
